literal_meaning: মুখকে ছোট করা (to make the face or mouth small)
figurative_meaning_en: To diminish the courage to speak or become hesitant in expression due to embarrassment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ভুল করে ফেলে মুখ ছোট করে চুপ করে গেল।
পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফল পেয়ে ছেলেটি মুখ ছোট করল।
example_sentences_in_english: After making a mistake, he shrank back and lost his voice.
Getting a bad result in the exam made the boy hesitant to speak up.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on social face and verbal restraint in awkward situations.
